SourceString: Welcome, visitor! I’m Luna, your guide to Pandora Battle.
Want to play with others? Open “Room list” on the title screen. Pick a room to join and you’ll enter its lobby.
Want to host your own room? Press the “Create room” button in the Room list to set the room name, map and max players.
Met a player you’d like to see again? Look for their “Add friend” button in the lobby’s player list.
Want to meet your friends in the same room? Try “Invite friends” in the lobby. Why not call over a friend to play with?
New to the game? Open “Guide” on the title screen. You’ll find everything from the game rules to how to use Pandoras and items.
Curious about your current tier? Check “Records” on the title screen for your tier, win count and past match records.
Created a room? Pick an arena in the lobby, too. Use the Previous map and Next map buttons in Map selection to browse other arenas.
Got the same weapon or equipment again? Combine duplicate weapons or equipment in your Inventory to upgrade them.
Not sure which weapon to use? Visit “Training” on the title screen. Try out different weapons yourself and find the one that suits you.
Skill descriptions show not only effects but also mana cost and cooldown. Check how much mana you need and how long until you can use it again.
The Fire Pandora’s “Burning Flare” deals damage over time with a zone of flames, while “Great Flame Sphere” launches a fireball. Both use fire, but they attack in different ways.
The Freeze Pandora’s “Icicle” fires an ice projectile, while “Frost Spike” makes ice spikes burst from the ground. Learn to tell their attacks apart.
The Freeze Pandora’s “Ice Age” strikes nearby enemies. Unlike skills that fire ice projectiles, it’s great for dealing with enemies up close.
The Darkness Pandora’s “Dark Stain” isn’t fired at enemies—it empowers you. Try using it before you start attacking.
The Darkness Pandora’s “Blackhole” pulls in nearby enemies. Remember that it gathers foes together, and get your next attack ready.
The Darkness Pandora’s “Void Ray” is an attack that fires a beam from your hand. Its role is different from “Dark Stain”, which empowers you.
To restore health, use the Light Pandora’s “Luminary Pulse”. To move quickly, try “Lightspeed”.
The Lightning Pandora’s “Lightning Flash” dashes forward and strikes enemies in its path. To hit a specific spot, try “Thunder Strike”, which calls down a lightning bolt.
The Machine Pandora’s “Guided Missile” tracks enemies and deals area damage. It attacks differently from “Plasma Beam”, which fires a beam.
The Machine Pandora isn’t all about attacks. “Defense Field” creates a protective field around you.
